scope: Current DOM/controller and actual Nc64 nodal worker protocol; exact CSV data/coverage checks, imports, stale-result/cancel controls. Not interactive Chrome/Firefox visual acceptance or physical/experimental validation.

checks.name: HTML loads current nodal solver/controller, not old constant-source library
default inverse inputs and empty initial output
real worker produces immediate visible progress and enables cancellation
actual profile contract retains nine samples on every panel
plots include true SI meridian, reconstruction/direct pressure and signed boundary residuals
JSON saves current method, inputs and honest diagnostic status
CSV has actual newline-separated rows and every direct/nodal sample
CSV direct Cp/velocity and metre coordinates match the actual solver samples
figure export contains five SVGs and explicit unqualified/nonexperimental labels
saved case import restores inputs only; no stale result/exports
legacy diagnostic/shape payload cannot become a fresh solution
cancel terminates and ignores a late result callback
imported explicit disk discretization is passed to the worker
new standard import does not inherit hidden diskPanels from the previous case
changed input invalidates prior plots and disables exports
wrong case schema is refused visibly
invalid JSON reports error and cannot revive any result
invalid imported geometry is rejected before any worker starts
